content:
anya: Opening a small docs PR to fix several things in the offline + private deploy guide. Noticed a mismatch between the RPM package service name, the systemd example, and the install path. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/899
dev-jules: dropping by to help with SDK snippets. Which snippets are wrong?
anya: Two spots: the python example sets env var `KMS_HOST` but CLI and the installer use `KMS_ENDPOINT`. Also the PKCS11 example references `libmyhsm.so` which is vendor-specific. I propose standardizing to `KMS_ENDPOINT` and adding a note with generic / vendor examples.
ops-lee: Also customers in airgapped orgs hit this: `docker load` step in the doc omits `--quiet` and the example image tag doesn't match our tar manifest; leads to "no such image" confusion. Suggest including exact commands we use in the release: `docker load -i redwood-offline-images-v1.2.tar && docker tag redwood:offline v1.2/redwood:offline`
rich: SELinux gotcha: for RHEL8 the installer creates /var/lib/redwood with root:root, then agent chowns to redwood:redwood at runtime. Recommend doc show pre-step: `semanage fcontext -a -t container_file_t '/var/lib/redwood(/.*)?'` and then `restorecon -R /var/lib/redwood` so customers don't hit AVC denies.
dev-jules: Good call. I'll add a short FAQ entry in the PR and a minimal systemd unit snippet that has two variants: `redwood-agent.service` and `redwood.service` with a comment "package-dependent".
anya: There's also a migration note needed for customers coming from older offline bundles (pre-2023-11). They used `redwood-kms-config.json` with `key_path` absolute paths. New installer expects `relative_keys` layout. Small script example would help: 
```
# convert old key paths to new layout
jq '.keys |= map(.path |= gsub("^/opt/oldkeys/"; "keys/"))' redwood-kms-config.json > redwood-kms-config.v2.json
```
ops-lee: Link fix: the HSM appendix anchor changed when we restructured security pages. The doc currently links to `/security/hsm.md#pkcs11` but new URL is `/security/hsm-guide.md#pkcs11-module`. I'll patch the link in the PR.
docs-bot: PR #899  linkcheck found 2 broken links (/security/hsm.md, /releases/offline-manifest.txt). CI log: https://ci.redwood.ai/build/12999
anya: I've updated the links and included the manifest example inline so the release manifest link is no longer required. Also added sha256 checksum command example and a note about `--no-same-owner` for tar extraction in airgapped installs.
dev-jules: I rewrote the Python SDK snippet to use envvar `KMS_ENDPOINT` and included an example for token auth vs mTLS. Short sample: 
```
import os
from redwood import Client
client = Client(kms_endpoint=os.getenv('KMS_ENDPOINT'), auth_method='token')
```
rich: Approved the SELinux text. ops-lee approved the docker snippet.
docs-bot: PR #899 ready for review (lint: pass, linkcheck: pass).
anya: Requesting final review from @dev-jules and @rich before merge.
dev-jules: LGTM, left minor nit on wording for the migration script.
rich: LGTM.
docs-bot: PR #899 merged by anya (commit a7b1c3d). Release note: docs v1.25.0 - "offline deploy: standardize KMS env vars, fix package/service names, update airgap image and SELinux guidance".
ops-lee: Updated internal ops-runbook with the new docker manifest example: https://wiki.redwood.ai/runbooks/offline-deploy (ops note: verify image tags on release cut).
